title: NUI designer style file
description: A house style for NUI windows: which generic rules to run, with their numbers (README, "Your own house style").

id.description: The style's id: what `pnpm check --style ID` takes and the editor remembers.

title.description: The name in the editor's Style select.

description.description: One or two sentences on the style, shown above its rules.

source.description: Where the house style is written down.

knownWindowKeys.description: Window keys your framework adds that the client ignores: the client check stops calling them unknown.

plugin.description: A .js or .mjs file beside this one (or below it) whose default export adds rules of your own. It is code: it runs with your rights, as any plugin.

rules.description: The rules to run, by id: true, false, or an object of settings and parameters. A rule not listed is off. With a plugin, its rules' ids take the common settings too.

fixed-size.description: Windows are not resizable. Default severity: warning.

enabled.description: false turns the rule off (a rule not listed is off too).

severity.description: The severity of every note the rule makes (default: the rule's own).

exempt.description: Windows the rule skips, by name: the form or document name, or a framework window's id.

title.description: The rule's name in the problem list (default: made from its parameters).

summary.description: One line saying what the rule wants, for the editor's rule list.
